sources.entry: Reeder 5 - News reader for Feedbin, Feedly, Feed Wrangler and so on. [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/pl/app/reeder-5/id1529448980?platform=mac)

summary.name: Reeder
summary.one_liner: Reeder is a news reader app that combines RSS feeds with videos, podcasts and social media posts in one unified timeline.
use_cases: Follow RSS feeds, videos and podcasts in one place
Pick up reading where you left off on other devices
Save links for later using the share extension
Create custom timelines filtered by keyword or media type
Keep a centralized overview of everything you follow
summary.what_it_does: The new Reeder acts as an inbox for content from various sources, including RSS feeds, videos, podcasts and social media posts, merged into a unified timeline. Custom timelines can be built with filters based on keywords, media types or feed types. Timeline position syncs across devices via iCloud instead of showing unread counts. Links can be saved to Reeder through its share extension, and tagged items such as Links, Favorites, Bookmarks and Later are synced. The page states Reeder is not meant to replace full-featured clients, and items can be opened in other apps when supported. The page states it collects no user data beyond what Apple collects.
notable: Unified timeline mixing RSS, videos, podcasts and social posts
Timeline position synced across devices instead of unread counts
Filters for custom timelines by keyword, media type or feed type
Privacy policy states no data is collected beyond Apple's
caveats: Not meant to replace full-featured clients; deeper interaction happens in other apps
Sync uses iCloud and covers only subscriptions, timeline position and tagged items
Pricing not stated on the page
